name: Shivaram Karanth Layout
text: Farmland and scrub scraped for a new layout's road grid in 2024 and 2025.
fact: The biggest loss on the map: 9 of the 30 largest losses we checked, side by side.

name: Shivaram Karanth Layout, east block
text: A second block of the same layout. Fields gave way to a road grid in 2024.

name: K Dommasandra and Kumbena Agrahara
text: Fields and a green wetland valley scraped and built on from 2023.

name: Varthur
text: Land beside Varthur Lake and the green valley west of its wetland cleared for building from 2023.

name: Panathur and the Varthur shore
text: Green plots inside the village and along the lake shore built over, year after year since 2020.

name: Ramapura
text: Buildings spreading across farmland year after year.

name: Kolathuru
text: Farmland cut by the new ring highway in 2022, then a large warehouse in 2024.

name: Channasandra
text: A green block scraped between 2023 and 2026.

name: Mutsandra
text: Farmland turned into a construction site from 2022.

name: Gudimavu
text: Plantation rows and fields cleared at the centre by 2026.

name: Tagachaguppe
text: The northern half built as a layout from 2021.

name: Hirandahalli
text: Fields and wetland edges cleared in 2025 and 2026.

name: Gattahalli
text: Fields south of Gattahalli Lake built on between 2024 and 2026.

name: Bhaktarahalli
text: Fields turned into sheds and buildings from 2022.

name: Lake at Guni Agrahara
text: A layout road laid along the lake's west edge, and the land around it scraped from 2024.

name: Lake at Dooravaninagar
text: A road widened on its west side and rail works along its south edge, 2024 to 2026.

name: Medi Agrahara Lake
text: A layout's road grid built right up to the shore in 2024.

name: Thubarahalli Lake
text: Towers built on the east edge, within 30 m of the water, by 2022.

name: Chittekarepalya Lake
text: Sheds built on the south edge, within 30 m of the water, in 2025 and 2026.

name: Bylakere Lake
text: Layout roads and plots laid around the lake between 2020 and 2023.

name: Yarandahalli Kere
text: The tank bed scraped in 2023, and a building on the north-east edge by 2025.

name: Lake at Mallapura, Nelamangala
text: A polyhouse and a building on the south-east edge in 2025 and 2026.
